title: Clerk billing split
description: Left: eyebrow, a two-line 32px heading, muted copy, a short checklist with circled ticks and a caret link. Right: a browser-window mock (traffic-light dots, centred title, a small app nav) showing a centred pricing heading and two white plan cards with a toggle, a graphite button and a ticked feature list, over a faint violet glow. On phones the window sits below and the plans scroll sideways.
notes: the plan cards are a mock (they show what a product's pricing page could look like), not a working pricing table
